a_priori_predictions: P1 signed circumcentric weights (C_signed/L) have linear precision: phi=x is reproduced exactly on every valid mesh
P2 on non-obtuse meshes DEVSIM absolute weights equal signed weights -> E1 exact on M1, M2
P3 on obtuse meshes E1 (absolute) breaks linear precision: interior residual r_i = sum_j (w_abs - w_signed)(phi_i - phi_j)
P4 if equation assembly multiplies an edge model by EdgeCouple, E2's effective weight is EdgeCouple^2 (not C/L)

P5 Poisson (x^2+y^2): with DEVSIM's own volume (= 0.25*sum |C| L) and absolute weights the quadratic part is self-consistent; the residual at the analytic nodal values is the linear-precision defect only: r_i = -(2/l^2) * x_i . sum_j w_abs,ij (x_j - x_i)

experiment_A.bc: Potential=0 V on left contact (x=0), 1 V on right contact (x=L); top/bottom natural (zero normal flux)

experiment_B.L_H: domain of each mesh (M*: 2e-4 x 1e-4 cm; scale2: 4e-4 x 2e-4 cm)
experiment_B.analytic_current_A_per_cm_depth: I = sigma*H/L*dV = 0.5 A/cm for every mesh (H/L = 0.5)
experiment_B.sign_convention: get_contact_current values are recorded as returned; the check is |I| vs analytic and I_left + I_right = 0; the sign must be opposite between the two contacts and the same for every mesh

C3.bc: Dirichlet phi on every boundary node (one contact on all boundary edges)
C3.sign: DEVSIM form div(Y)+Z=0 with Y=-grad(phi): -lap(phi)+Z=0 -> Z=+lap(phi)

tolerances.justification: linear problems, one direct-LU Newton step; ~50-node systems have rounding ~1e-13; EXACT_* leaves 1000x margin; SIGNIFICANT is 1e4 x EXACT

spec.units: coordinates um in fixtures; DEVSIM receives float64 cm = um*1e-4
